h1: Custom Tentree Beanies for Bulk Orders
metaDescription: Order custom Tentree beanies for your brand. Eco-friendly, organic cotton beanies perfect for bulk corporate gifts and events.
introHtml: Tentree beanies combine sustainable style with brand visibility. Made from organic cotton, each beanie supports Tentree's mission of planting ten trees per item. These beanies are ideal for eco-conscious companies seeking promotional apparel that aligns with their green values. Choose from a range of natural colors and add your logo via embroidery or screen printing for a soft, comfortable fit that your team and customers will wear proudly.
heroAltText: Custom Tentree beanies in organic cotton with embroidered logo, displayed on a model wearing a cozy knit hat
